title: きさらぎ賞の後に・次はいよいよ……

text_block_list.name: Special Week
choice_data_list: Congrats! That was some nice running out there!
Congrats! That was some nice running out there!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Uhh… I felt like I was in some kinda dream, and… before I knew it, I was at the finish line!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Anyways, thank you! I've really gotten faster, haven't I?!
choice_data_list: Up next is the race you've been waiting for—the Japanese Derby.
Up next is the race you've been waiting for—the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: If we keep working together, I'll get faster and faster. And then I'll win that race—just you wait and see!
